releases.notes:
## 26.2-1.8.0

Face the Daleks in new forms — towering Paradigm Daleks, bronze Time War casings, and the mutants inside, now shouting "Exterminate!" — meet the peaceful Thals, and find Dalek outposts and Thal settlements on Skaro.

### Added
- Entity: Paradigm Dalek (five castes: Drone, Strategist, Scientist, Eternal, Supreme)
- Entity: Dalek Mutant
- Entity: Thal (four looks)
- Item: Paradigm Dalek Spawn Egg
- Item: Dalek Mutant Spawn Egg
- Item: Thal Spawn Egg
- Item: Dalek Laser Gun
- Misc: Bronze Time War Dalek variants alongside the 1963 Dalek
- Misc: Destroyed Daleks can release a mutant that crawls out and attacks
- Misc: Rare solo Paradigm Daleks patrol Skaro
- Misc: Daleks shout "Exterminate!" on locking a target, with spoken idle, hurt and death lines
- Misc: Dalek outposts generate on Skaro, in intact and ruined forms
- Misc: Rare Thal settlements on the Thal Plateau, home to resident Thals
- Misc: Thals wander, open doors, look at nearby players and flee from Daleks
- Misc: Dalek/Thal battles

### Changed
- Misc: Classic Dalek rebuilt as 1963 and Time War casings, and shrunk to 1.7 blocks tall
- Misc: Time War Dalek lens and dome lights glow in the dark
- Misc: Daleks now target Thals
- Misc: Dalek Laser Gun bolts fired by players hurt Daleks and Dalek mutants

- Misc: Ambient Skaro radiation (biome-scaled; full EVA suit blocks it; no lingering dose)
- Misc: Handheld radiation meter colour-coded screen; console reader and sonic Scan agree
- Misc: Petrified Jungle flora (trees, snags, fallen logs)
- Misc: Field Guide Skaro Survival chapter
- Misc: First-person EVA helmet visor overlay

### Changed
- Misc: TARDIS listed in the Functional Blocks creative tab
- Misc: Landing search deferred off the materialisation lever so travel does not hitch the server
- Misc: Demat/mat lever overlays removed
- Misc: Planet locator discovers Skaro; biome dial cycles the five Skaro regions
- Misc: Skaro has no vanilla hostiles, cave fauna, or farm animals

## 26.2-1.6.0

Repair a found Type 40 — craftable console circuits, a live artron tank, and Zeiton fuel — plus a Field Guide and a setting-based sonic.

### Added

- Block: Gallifrey Cobblestone Stairs

- Misc: Field Guide (G, first-join book, or Mod Menu) with Quick Start, Sonic, Circuits, and Console Room chapters
- Misc: Worldgen Type 40s start unfinished (broken circuits, 30 artron, same-world hops until repaired)
- Misc: Owner-only console piloting (readers and refueler stay public; bound key still unlocks doors)
- Misc: Live artron tank (0–500; Zeiton Crystals add 25; demat and summon spend 10 same-world or 30 to change dimension)
- Misc: Zeiton ore in Gallifrey stone and rare Overworld traces
- Misc: Sonic field-mode HUD carousel; pair with your TARDIS for Seal, Scan, and Ping
- Misc: Doctor Who first-hour and sonic teaching advancement trees

### Changed
- Misc: Crafted sonics start with Open only until settings are installed or the TARDIS handshake
- Misc: Found worldgen TARDISes need spare circuits; creative, placed, and existing saves without new flags stay fully fitted and full
- Misc: Only the owner can fly the console
- Misc: Panel 5 refueler is a live artron tank fed with Zeiton Crystals
- Misc: Bigger-on-the-inside and smaller-on-the-outside doorways use streamed lighting and atmosphere fog
- Misc: TARDIS and console inventory icons are 3D; sonic GUI sprites
- Misc: Using a sonic on TARDIS doors no longer opens them
- Misc: Automatic surface landings stay below a dimensional bedrock ceiling

releases.notes:
## 1.0.0+26.2

Initial Screenplay release: real-client YAML scenario harness for Fabric, Forge, and NeoForge.

### Added
- Fabric, Forge, and NeoForge client harness artifacts
- Gradle plugin for runScreenplay / runScreenplayTests with xvfb support
- YAML scenarios, JUnit reports, metrics, and screenshot capture

## 26.2-1.5.0

Gallifrey comes alive — Time Lord wanderers, Broakir, Flutterwings, and tameable Mewing Dogs, plus smoother TARDIS doorway previews.

### Added
- Entity: Broakir
- Entity: Flutterwing
- Entity: Mewing Dog
- Entity: Time Lord
- Item: Broakir Spawn Egg
- Item: Flutterwing Spawn Egg
- Item: Mewing Dog Spawn Egg
- Item: Time Lord Spawn Egg
- Misc: Broakir, Flutterwing, and Time Lords spawn on Gallifrey plains and forest
- Misc: Flutterwings appear as Blue Crystal, Madrigal, Silverband, or Wild Endeavour
- Misc: Time Lords wander in four robe variants
- Misc: Mewing Dogs spawn in Gallifrey forest (tame with a bone; sit, follow, dye collar, and breed)

### Changed
- Misc: Bigger-on-the-inside doorway preview restored after a rendering regression
- Misc: Console room preloads near the exterior so the doorway look-in is ready when doors open
